info.title: API.SH: Investing.com
info.description: The Investing.com API from API.SH: public Investing.com data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free

get.description:
Analysis and opinion articles from Investing.com, by section or for one instrument: title, summary, author, publish and update time, comments, editor's pick, image and link.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/investing-analysis

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: An instrument's symbol: its analysis articles instead of a section.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: An instrument's numeric id, instead of symbol.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass next_page from the previous response.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A market table from Investing.com: commodities by group (real-time futures, metals, energy, grains, softs, meats) and other market lists (commodity indices, major indices, index futures, major currencies, crypto), each row with name, symbol, last price, high, low, change, change percent over a day, week, month and year, volume and update time.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/investing-commodities

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The constituents of an index (S&P 500, Dow Jones, Nasdaq 100, DAX...) with each one's live price, change, day range, 52-week range, volume, exchange, country and link. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/investing-components

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Index id (166 = S&P 500, 169 = Dow Jones, 172 = DAX).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Paging cursor from the previous page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Upcoming and past ex-dividend dates from Investing.com for a date range and countries: company, symbol, dividend amount, frequency, payment date and yield.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/investing-dividends-calendar

parameters.name: to

parameters.name: countries

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Rows to skip. Pass next_offset from the previous response.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Company earnings releases for a date range: date, timing (before the open, after the close), release time once reported, the company (id, symbol, name, exchange, country, currency, sector id, links), fiscal year and quarter, period end, EPS and revenue forecasts, actuals and surprise percentages, and the share price before and after the release. Filter by country, importance and sector. Up to 92 days per call. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/investing-earnings-calendar

parameters.name: countries
parameters.description: Comma-separated countries: US, GB, EZ (euro zone), DE, FR, IT, ES, JP, CN, AU, CA, NZ, CH, IN, BR, HK, KR, MX, or Investing.com numeric country ids. Default: all.

parameters.name: importance
parameters.description: Comma-separated company importance levels: low, medium, high. Default: all.

parameters.name: sectors
parameters.description: Comma-separated Investing.com sector ids (as in `instrument.sector_id`). Default: all.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:

Up to 92 days per call. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/investing-economic-calendar

parameters.name: countries
parameters.description: Comma-separated countries: US, GB, EZ (euro zone), DE, FR, IT, ES, JP, CN, AU, CA, NZ, CH, IN, BR, HK, KR, MX, or Investing.com numeric country ids. Default: all.

parameters.name: importance
parameters.description: Comma-separated importance levels: low, medium, high. Default: all.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A stock's financial statements from Investing.com: the income statement, balance sheet or cash flow statement, annual (about 10 years) or quarterly, every line the site shows (each with growth and margin lines where it has them) keyed by name, in millions of the reporting currency, newest period first; or the ratios page (about 50 valuation, profitability, growth, dividend and efficiency ratios, each with the industry value).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/investing-financials

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Ticker, e.g. `AAPL`. Combine with `exchange` or `country` when the ticker is listed in several places.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: annual (default) or quarterly. Not used for ratios.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Historical prices of an Investing.com instrument for a date range: one bar per day, week or month with date, open, high, low, close, volume and change percent, newest first. Default range: the last 90 days (daily), year (weekly) or 5 years (monthly) up to `to`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/investing-historical

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Investing.com instrument id (from `/investing/v1/search`), e.g. `6408` (Apple), `166` (S&P 500), `1` (EUR/USD), `8830` (Gold futures), `1057391` (Bitcoin/USD). Give `id` or `symbol`.

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Ticker or symbol, e.g. `AAPL`, `TSLA`, `EUR/USD`, `BTC/USD`; the best-matching instrument is used (narrow it with `exchange` or `country`).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
News headlines from Investing.com for a section or for one instrument: id, title, summary (the first lines), link, publish and update time, source, author, image, comment count, editor's pick and the instruments the story mentions (with their change percent), plus the section's most popular stories. Give `section`, or `id`/`symbol` for an instrument's news. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/investing-news

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Instrument id for its news (instead of `section`).

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Instrument symbol for its news (instead of `section`).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Live quote of one Investing.com instrument: price, change, open, high, low, previous close, bid/ask, volume and 3-month average, 52-week high and low, pre-market and after-hours prices, market status; for stocks market cap, revenue, P/E, EPS, beta, dividend, shares outstanding and next earnings date; performance (day, week, month, YTD, 1 and 3 years); technical summary (hourly, daily, weekly, monthly: strong sell to strong buy); contract details for futures.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/investing-quote

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Investing.com instrument id (from `/investing/v1/search`), e.g. `6408` (Apple), `166` (S&P 500), `1` (EUR/USD), `8830` (Gold futures), `1057391` (Bitcoin/USD). Give `id` or `symbol`.

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Ticker or symbol, e.g. `AAPL`, `TSLA`, `EUR/USD`, `BTC/USD`; the best-matching instrument is used (narrow it with `exchange` or `country`).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search Investing.com instruments (stocks, ETFs, indices, currencies, commodities, crypto, bonds, funds) by name or symbol: id, symbol, name, type, exchange, country, currency, link, and the live quote (price, change, day range, 52-week range, volume, pre-market and after-hours prices). `total` is the number of matches. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page. With `type`, each page reads 50 matches and keeps those of the chosen kinds, so a page can hold fewer results (or none) while `next_cursor` continues.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/investing-search

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Only these instrument kinds, comma-separated: stock, etf, index, crypto, currency, commodity, bond, fund, futures. `limit` is ignored with type.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
